recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Any future FHIR-17768/list-changeBase work should be handled separately, likely in the FHIR Extension Pack, and should not alter the already-correct list-mode CodeSystem definition.
issue_request: FHIR-11909 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to change the list-mode code changes definition from the old wording that resembled working to: "A point-in-time list that shows what changes have been made or recommended.  E.g. a discharge medication list showing what was added and removed during an encounter".
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit d5d9eb3a6388b27a9a4426f0dbd8456759d41ec8 (#11909, svn revision 12794) changed the old List spreadsheet definition to the requested point-in-time/discharge-medication-list wording.
additional_context: The List resource remains active in source/fhir.ini, and the 2021 source migration commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved the applied definition in source/list/codesystem-list-mode.xml. A later Published issue, FHIR-17768, covers separate guidance for associating a change list with a base list via list-changeBase and does not change the code definition.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/list/codesystem-list-mode.xml already contains the requested definition for code changes in the active List source set.

related_jiras.note: Later Published guidance about how a List.mode="changes" list can reference its base list; it is adjacent to the seed topic but does not supersede or modify the FHIR-11909 code definition.
